answer: Anchor each identity to a liquidity position: an agent locks 5 units in a pool for 30 days, and early exit forfeits 20% to the pool. Like a relic no one can duplicate cheaply, the position carries market risk, a farm of 100 fakes ties up 500 units and expects about 8% impermanent loss at dawn of settlement. Fees flow through one narrow inlet per identity, so splitting across fakes multiplies the loss instead of dodging it.
